open.name: ICU (V8 dependency)
open.reason: Pending the owner's licence reading. ICU's root LICENSE names five files with their own terms: vendor/json/upstream/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp, aclocal.m4, config.guess and install-sh (each 'only for ICU4C') and sorttable.js ('only for ICU4J'). aclocal.m4 (GPL-2.0-or-later) and config.guess (GPL-3.0-or-later) carry GNU GPL notices, each with the Autoconf exception; both are Autoconf build-system files. The supplier's ICU build file (third_party/v8/icu.BUILD.bazel of openai/codex at 086ccc833bc9cf01024ad2dd6af7dbd421b6bf9a, blob 833c2f027a06d89fa322f5433358383d286682f5, read from a retained copy whose blob equals its tree entry) compiles source/common/**/*.h and *.cpp, source/i18n/**/*.h and *.cpp and source/stubdata/stubdata.cpp, and carries common/icudtl.dat as data; it names none of the five files. The GPL texts those notices refer to are not held. Whether the notices concern anything in the shipped library is a question of licence applicability, not decided here.

components.below_root: Root LICENSE, which carries ICU's third-party terms in its own sections, including notices for five named files (see reason). The retained listing at d578f2e8 is the root only (license.html, 622 bytes, is not held); subdirectories were not listed.
components.reason: Pending the owner's licence reading. ICU's root LICENSE names five files with their own terms: vendor/json/upstream/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp, aclocal.m4, config.guess and install-sh (each 'only for ICU4C') and sorttable.js ('only for ICU4J'). aclocal.m4 (GPL-2.0-or-later) and config.guess (GPL-3.0-or-later) carry GNU GPL notices, each with the Autoconf exception; both are Autoconf build-system files. The supplier's ICU build file (third_party/v8/icu.BUILD.bazel of openai/codex at 086ccc833bc9cf01024ad2dd6af7dbd421b6bf9a, blob 833c2f027a06d89fa322f5433358383d286682f5, read from a retained copy whose blob equals its tree entry) compiles source/common/**/*.h and *.cpp, source/i18n/**/*.h and *.cpp and source/stubdata/stubdata.cpp, and carries common/icudtl.dat as data; it names none of the five files. The GPL texts those notices refer to are not held. Whether the notices concern anything in the shipped library is a question of licence applicability, not decided here.

limits: An account of what the package is built to carry, from committed inputs; it is not read from a built package.

A notice text is the publisher's licence or notice text for the component at the named version or revision; whether it satisfies the licence is not decided here, except where an owner licence reading is recorded.

Supplier components inside an executable are as the supplier's build files and package records state; they are not read from the binaries. Below a repository's root, only the texts a row lists are included.

Each text is recorded with the repository and revision it comes from, or as a member of the supplier tree. Below a repository's root, only what a row lists is included (V8's third_party licences); each row's below_root says what was examined.

Which component is inside which member follows the supplier's build files and package records (Codex third_party/v8 build files, the rg selector, the voice manifest and sources.json); it is the supplier's statement in its source, not read from the binaries.
The executable rule (an execute bit, not .dylib or .json) fits this distribution record, checked against its Mach-O count; it is not a general proof that a file is a compiled program.
